arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Withroe argued no private right of action exists under Section 1983.
Mr. Piotrowski stated an APA challenge was not a viable alternative.
Mr. Kneedler explained Medicaid differs from other Spending Clause programs.
